description: This file contains functions and schemas for fetching and parsing Vercel AI Gateway models, including API calls, data validation schemas, and model parsing logic.

methods.name: getVercelAiGatewayModels
methods.description: Fetches models from Vercel AI Gateway API, filters for language models, and returns a record of ModelInfo objects.

methods.name: parseVercelAiGatewayModel
methods.description: Parses a VercelAiGatewayModel object into a ModelInfo object, including pricing and feature support details.
